purpose: Source-authored predicate contract for custom law profiles that depend on battle geometry. This is planning evidence only; it does not prove live hex coordinates, adjacency, line/range predicates, action payload geometry, or authorize gameplay mutation.
requiredRuntimeProof: melee versus ranged action classifier proof

correlationRequired: target unable-to-retaliate or negative-status predicate when used
dungeon.boxed-disabled-flanked-bonus.notes: Dungeon Kill Corridors requires proving the target is boxed, flanked, disabled, or unable to retaliate in the current action geometry.

correlationRequired: current incoming or defensive action payload
forbiddenSubstitutes: any negative status without defensive geometry
fortress.slow-poison-defensive-line.notes: Fortress Bog Line requires proving defensive geometry or slowed/poisoned enemy pressure in the current action context.

forbiddenSubstitutes: any summoned unit without entry hex proof
inferno.gating-teleport-adjacency.notes: Inferno Hellpack Assault requires proving gated/teleported entry identity and entry-to-target adjacency.

correlationRequired: friendly shooter and adjacent protector identity
native Avenger mark predicate when used
forbiddenSubstitutes: any enemy in range without Avenger/protection context
rampart.protect-shooter-avenger-mark.notes: Rampart Hunter Pairs requires proving shooter/protector adjacency or native Avenger-marked target geometry in the current action.
